title: Object Storage: outage refund handling
content:
Object Storage outage refund is handled on request. Pay one authorized storage overpayment refund through the original ACH payment destination. The agent records an immediate positive receivable delta for cash returned; the posted receipt confirms the payout is complete.

## Invocation

refund_storage_overpayment_1b2c5ab5. This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters

- storage_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the selected storage evidence or assessment copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage refund input.
- storage_holding_id: Id class — Identifier of the storage contract copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage refund input.
- source_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the original invoice or completed payment copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage refund input.
- request_id: Id class — Identifier of the customer claim or refund authorization copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage refund input.
- customer_id: Id class — Identifier of the enterprise customer profile copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage refund input.
- amount: Fixed-format class — Unit USD; format USD to two decimals. Signed financial receivable delta as a decimal number, rounded half-up before submission and stored to two decimal places; empty is not allowed. This is the outage refund input.

## Successful return

For outage refund, a string reading Recorded with the storage business record identifier and the USD amount; Recorded confirms that the stated action completed successfully.
